title: Concept: ASP.NET Razor template error returned to a client
description: A ASP.NET Razor template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The compiler error names the view file, the line and the symbol, which is the view layer an attacker would use to test server-side template injection.
applicability: Deployments that render a ASP.NET Razor template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The compiler error names the view file, the line and the symbol, which is the view layer an attacker would use to test server-side template injection.
